verdict.rationale: Mailgun's webhooks API docs say real-time email event data is pushed directly to your application, so you can automate responses without API polling. The tracked events this would deliver (opens, clicks, bounces, complaints, unsubscribes) are documented separately. Missing for 10: detail on which event types are subscribable, webhook signature verification and retry behavior, programmatic webhook management, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
